minimodem --rx --alsa=plughw:1,0 1200 -q

echo "Hello World!"|minimodem --tx --alsa=plughw:1,0 1200
while read line; do echo "$line"; done | minimodem --tx --alsa=plughw:1,0 1200 2>/dev/null

rm -f /var/lib/bluetooth/B8:27:EB:B4:B1:61/cache/0A:62:28:18:1B:50

arecord -D "bluealsa:DEV=0A:62:28:18:1B:50,PROFILE=a2dp" -f S16_LE -c 2 -r 44100 -t raw 2>/dev/null | sox -r 44100 -e signed -b 16 -c 2 -t raw - -c 1 -t wav - 2>/dev/null | minimodem --rx -f - --quiet 1200
